views.rationale: AAPL's new product announcements, including the MacBook Pro 14-in., MacBook Pro 16-in., and iMac, are expected to drive sales growth in the next quarter.
AMZN's variable marketing costs, largely based on growth in sales and changes in rates, are expected to have a minimal impact on sales in the next quarter.
BA's slowdown in production and delivery of 737-9 aircraft due to the FAA's enhanced inspection process is expected to negatively impact sales in the next quarter.

BAC's allocation of capital to its business segments, considering regulatory capital requirements and internal risk-based capital models, is expected to have a minimal impact on sales in the next quarter.
CAT's discussion of cautionary statements related to future events and expectations is expected to have a minimal impact on sales in the next quarter.
CVX's third quarter 2024 earnings by business segment, with a decrease in upstream earnings, is expected to have a minimal impact on sales in the next quarter.
Google Services and Google Cloud reported a 5.6% operational increase in the fiscal nine months of 2024.
